channel.title: Just Halloween Crafts
channel.description: DIY Halloween crafts, costumes, printables and party treats

item.title: Edible Halloween Crafts Kids Can Make (and Eat)
item.description: Eight edible Halloween crafts kids can make and eat: banana ghosts, clementine pumpkins, cracker spiders, pretzel broomsticks and more, with safety tips.

item.title: Free Printable Halloween Crafts: Templates, Silhouettes and Labels
item.description: Every free printable Halloween craft on the site in one place: silhouettes, templates, banner letters, door signs and potion labels, plus printing tips.

item.title: How to Store Halloween Decorations So They Last for Years
item.description: How to pack away Halloween decorations so they last: sorting, cleaning, the best boxes, and storage tips for wreaths, costumes, lights and crafts.

item.title: Felt Halloween Finger Puppets: Ghost, Pumpkin, Bat and Cat
item.description: Make felt Halloween finger puppets with simple shapes: a ghost, pumpkin, bat, black cat and witch. Sewn or glued, with sizing tips and easy stitches.

item.title: Glow-in-the-Dark Halloween Crafts: 6 Easy Projects
item.description: Six easy glow-in-the-dark Halloween crafts, from glowing ghost jars to spooky eyes in the bushes, plus tips to make glow paint shine brighter.

item.title: Paper Plate Halloween Masks Kids Can Make
item.description: Make paper plate Halloween masks with kids: a pumpkin, black cat, bat, ghost and friendly monster, with simple steps and tips for safe eye holes.

item.title: How to Make DIY Potion Bottles for Halloween Decor
item.description: Turn old jars and bottles into spooky potion bottles: clean them, age the glass, fill them with colored liquids or dry ingredients, then cork and label them.

item.title: Painted Halloween Rocks: Easy Designs and Tips That Last
item.description: Paint Halloween rocks that last: how to pick and prep stones, the best paints and sealers, and easy pumpkin, ghost, monster and spider designs for all ages.

item.title: Halloween Sensory Bin Ideas for Toddlers and Preschoolers
item.description: Seven Halloween sensory bin ideas for toddlers and preschoolers, from pumpkin oats to a spider web rescue, with fillers, safety tips and easy clean-up advice.

item.title: Egg Carton Halloween Crafts: Bats, Spiders and Little Monsters
item.description: Turn cardboard egg cartons into bats, spiders, monsters and a pumpkin garland. Easy Halloween crafts for kids with simple steps and a supply list.

item.title: How to Make a Wizard Wand with Chopsticks and Hot Glue
item.description: Turn a wooden chopstick into a wizard wand with hot glue swirls, paint and a little dry brushing. Easy steps, design ideas and safety tips for kids.

item.title: The Best Fabric for a Cloak or Cape (and What to Avoid)
item.description: Fleece, velvet, cotton, satin or wool? Compare the best fabrics for a Halloween cloak or cape, how much you need, and which ones are easiest to sew.

item.title: How to Make a Witch's Broom from Twigs and a Stick
item.description: Make a rustic witch's broom for a costume or porch display using a garden stick, a bundle of twigs and twine. Step-by-step, with tips to make it last.

item.title: How to Make a Witch Hat from Felt or Card
item.description: Make a witch hat from felt or card with one cone and one brim. Simple measuring, a no-sew option, and ideas for bending the tip and decorating it.

item.title: How to Make Coffee Filter Ghosts: Easy Kids Craft
item.description: Learn how to make coffee filter ghosts: an easy, low-cost Halloween craft for kids, plus ideas for ghost garlands, glowing ghosts and window decorations.

item.title: How to Host a Halloween Craft Party for Kids
item.description: How to host a Halloween craft party for kids: planning, easy craft stations, a sample schedule, spooky snacks, safety tips and take-home favors.

item.title: How to Make Mason Jar Halloween Lanterns
item.description: How to make mason jar Halloween lanterns step by step: painted jack-o'-lantern jars, mummy jars and tissue paper luminaries lit safely with LED tea lights.

item.title: No-Carve Pumpkin Decorating Ideas for Halloween
item.description: Easy no-carve pumpkin decorating ideas for Halloween: painted faces, decoupage, push pins, yarn and foam monsters. Safe for kids and longer-lasting.

item.title: Salt Dough Halloween Ornaments: Recipe and Ideas
item.description: Make salt dough Halloween ornaments with a simple 3-ingredient recipe. Includes baking and air-drying times, painting tips and spooky decoration ideas.

item.title: Toilet Paper Roll Halloween Crafts for Kids
item.description: Easy toilet paper roll Halloween crafts for kids: bats, mummies, black cats, monsters, owls and glowing eyes, made from cardboard tubes and simple supplies.

item.title: Make Your Own Halloween Fairy Door Craft
item.description: Make your own Halloween fairy door craft: turn a plain wooden fairy door into a witch house with paint and altered art techniques, step by step.

item.title: How to Make a Spider Web Halloween Banner
item.description: How to make a spider web Halloween banner using cutting dies, spiderweb doilies or paper webs, for spooky cobweb decorations that hang well.

item.title: Chocolate Orange Cupcakes: Halloween Treats
item.description: Chocolate orange cupcakes for Halloween: zesty orange buttercream on rich chocolate cupcakes, in classic Fall colors for party treats.

item.title: How to Make a Perler Bead Spider Web Pattern
item.description: Make a Perler bead spider web on a hexagon pegboard: lay three spokes, add two rings of beads, then iron. Hang it as decor or use it as a cupcake topper.

item.title: Hairy Hobbit Feet Cookies for Halloween
item.description: How to make feet cookies: cut vanilla sugar cookies with a foot cutter, pipe chocolate toenails and add grated chocolate hair. A fun Halloween bake.
